title: Non-local gravity effects in cosmological dynamics probed by IceCube/KM3NeT signals and dark matter relic abundance
summary: Non-local gravity terms have a relevant role in determining the cosmological dynamics. Here we consider curvature- and torsion-based cosmological models where non-local terms can be ``scalarised'' and then reduced under the standard of scalar-tensor gravity. In this context, we study the role of non-local cosmology with regards to the recent results reported by the IceCube/KM3NeT experiments, which revealed high-energy astrophysical neutrino fluxes up to energies of $220$\,PeV.
